ADVISOR SIGNOFF — STORY-1889 remaining-floor extraction and STORY-1917 source ownership, 2026-10-25. Read complete source-only report /tmp/codex2-story1889-remaining-floor-map.txt plus signed acceptance and existing rulings. Independently verified protected mandate_ship trusts mandate_traces::collect_pr/store_snapshot/store_snapshot_stable, batch confirm_and_ship owns typed human/clear/ship conditions, and relay restart records govern the durable restart limit. All five retained exact production floor paths have real authority responsibilities; no canonical final-acceptance exception was found. Accept the report as the bounded completion map, NOT source approval or an immutable verdict.
Full final STORY-1889 acceptance remains gate/ prefix + .aida/config.toml + protected test files, with no grandfathered authority or unprotected gate reexports/mounts. Do not delete the five entries while their authority remains outside, add exemptions, rename to evade, claim historical-only completion, or replace the requested architecture with a permanently broader floor.
Approved pure-move clusters:
- dispatch: existing admitted request/schema meanings, target/spec restrictions, request revalidation and mandate/grant/seat/delegation admission; include newly introduced claim/result transition admission where current STORY-1917 adds it. Keep CLI/rendering/raw copying/publication/execution orchestration outside. Protect authority-bearing record interpretation and all admitted-record mutation; no unprotected full-record return can change authority after checks.
- drive: actual route/spec/signoff/restart/held-PR/unowned admission functions and exact inline drive/scope/recheck decision blocks. Preserve comparisons, original mandate binding, short-circuit order and refusal bytes; leave scheduling loops, process execution, notifications and bookkeeping outside.
- trace evidence: gate-specific committed trace/path attribution and fail-closed snapshot stability meanings plus their evidence types/readers. Ordinary unrelated store-history/report helpers stay outside. An unprotected helper returning trusted empty exclusions/paths or stable=true is not a complete boundary.
- relay lineage: existing trusted record schema/codec/private-file validation, lineage interpretation and durable append that enforces restart eligibility. This is not a relay orchestrator move; actual spawning, shell setup, scheduling and logs remain outside.
- ship batch: existing same-head independent verdict/CI selectors and human/typed-PR/typed-clear/guarded-clear+ship decisions, including initial human-only/go admission. Retain NONE overrides, exact pins/refusals and clear/ship order. Keep discovery, refresh, waiting and reporting outside; preserve a narrow existing ports seam rather than inventing a permit framework.
Source ownership/sequence is explicit. Current agy2 branch has committed e3db5cf7fb9d7c6300a27b4adbe59493e8499e29 (1917 checkpoints1/2) and uncommitted checkpoint3 dispatch_flow.rs + gate/dispatch_auth.rs + native pr_cmd/pr_train hooks. The shorter 1889 dispatch snapshot lacks the newer recovery/claim/unknown-owner fencing. Ag y1 (agy1) owns the remaining mechanical 1889 extraction; agy2 retains current 1917 behavior and dispatch edits through its signed R6/Q2 checkpoint. No competing edit to agy2's worktree or replay of stale dispatch.rs.
Agy1 may complete the four non-dispatch clusters while 1917 finishes. Keep dispatch.rs protected in the interim and keep final1889/PR4 incomplete. Finish the shared dispatch extraction only after normal integration of the independently reviewed, landed 1917 source, using that current interface and preserving every claim/recovery/original-mandate/native-checkpoint fence. STORY-1917 already has an existing gate/ prefix on main and can finish its behavior there; do not introduce a dependency on unmerged 1889 changes. Do not smuggle 1917 behavior into a supposedly pure 1889 diff. If an actual type/privacy or integration obstacle prevents this order, report the exact symbols before changing the plan; no forced reset/rebase or silent scope reduction.
Move policy tests and their real compiled mounts into protected gate/tests; leave orchestration-only tests outside. Final callers use direct gate paths. Preserve serde/default semantics, all existing behavior and before/after refusal inventory, including dynamic prefixes. Existing strict ratchets/folded TASK-2319/2335/1863/1864 and full PhaseB remain mandatory. This is an accepted extraction/ownership plan, not a new gate policy, source verdict, hold clearance, merge or permission to complete either story early. STORY-1889's explicit operator-merge condition remains. Local gates retain the existing targeted-area + fast rule, with touched/compile only shared test infrastructure or >10 files, and exact-head CI/independent review.
subject: Signed remaining-floor extraction; serialize current1917 dispatch
